notes.title: Climate Changes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Temperature[/b][/h2]

1.Biomes will be characterized by varying temperatures that may result in discomfort or potential harm to the body and feet. Wearing appropriate clothing and footwear can provide insulation and protection, as well as maintain durability despite wear and tear.

2.When you are indoors in a room with surrounding walls, you are shielded from potential harm caused by the environment. The presence of heat or cold sources inside the room will impact the temperature within. A comparison of the environmental heat levels before and after a fire is introduced is shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4d41420cdd37a1bedf7f6328d28455a580e1a1b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/d34846621e8090f5575d54eee548a1a252943c1f.png[/img]

3.Standing directly beside to a fire or any heat source will have a greater effect on you, both indoors and outdoors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/62099e4b75755c6471d9a9e92f49a127877567f9.png[/img]

4.Drinking water will temporarily lower your body temperature. Making it beneficial to bring water with you when visiting warmer biomes such as deserts or jungles. Furthermore, certain foods can also causing temporary increases or decreases of body temperature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/2488bf5518c3b39fcf2bb46fa33a65320186ea35.png[/img]

5.When your body temperature is negative, your metabolic rate will increase in order to sustain basic bodily functions. Therefore you will start to use more food per minute just to stay alive. If the impact becomes significant enough to cause concern, a debuff icon will be displayed. The number on the icon indicates your current rate of food consumption per minute (67 per minute in this instance).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/b26fe581eeb3866d1a72a32630e80ef8d43f3ae2.png[/img]

6.When your body temperature is too high, a separate debuff will be activated causing your stamina to deplete at a quicker rate during work or physical activity. This debuff indicates the percentage increase in stamina cost for you.

To alleviate this issue, it is recommended to hydrate with water or seek a cooler environment such as a room with a fan to lower your body temperature and improve efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/81b89787e3797b1dc257d2a134c533bdd0d0a754.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rooms[/b][/h2]

The maximum dimensions for a room will be 16 tiles wide and 16 tiles tall. Anything larger will be classified as an outdoor area.

We are able to measure the size of each room and identify any permanent fixtures present, such as a fire pit, furnace, or oven. By analyzing the size and equipment within a room, we can determine its intended purpose and provide special benefits when you occupy that space.

In this update, we will only be implementing a limited portion of this feature, granting a stamina recovery boost to all rooms above a certain size.

Future updates will further enhance this feature, with benefits such as increased blacksmithing proficiency in a Smithy, improved stamina recovery in a Bedroom, and enhanced cooking abilities in a Kitchen, among others.

[h2][b]Mannequins[/b][/h2]

In order to streamline the process of dressing and changing attire, a new Mannequin object will be introduced. This object allows for a set of clothes and shoes to be placed on it, with a single command facilitating the switch between the current attire and the items on the mannequin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/61aa626254dc76b050d67cc8d3d954cf177333ee.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hopper-Powered Fan[/b][/h2]

If a hopper is placed in this device and properly fed, it will generate cool air. This functionality is most effective when used within an enclosed structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/86157f82c7ff9bfcaa22b4abf039249b1ccbca95.png[/img]

[h2][b]Straw Clothing[/b][/h2]

A new type of clothing that can be made without the need for specific tools such as an awl or rope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/114c2342330d9ebf63534e4c1de65a0170949f33.png[/img]

notes.title: Transportation Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/7e8ec6e3e429ff3c658fc3727d791252426a42ba.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pushcart[/b][/h2]
Invented during Bronze Age 1.
This carry more weight than a sled and will cost less stamina to run with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/351f337f5e8f7edfbfba32d6990a28c2c0877d12.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pull Cart [/b][/h2]
Invented during Iron Age 1.
Heavier than pushcart, but more efficient for heavy items, and can take 6 items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/858210c7c19951c2cf6b7daa78417dadf0e4283d.png[/img]

[h2][b]Kirisaur[/b][/h2]

During Iron Age 3, you can find strange egg that has lied buried in the desert sands for millennia. Once hatched you will have a loyal riding pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/15479a99f125cec8f624da745afba10399607b23.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/c8c089d206473d1555f9e18ba3ab852170a8639f.png[/img]

You can ride the Kirisaur once it reaches adulthood and has a saddle.

The passenger can hunt from the kirisaur back, and will have higher range compared to when standing on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/69298f7806198c605a4a9e2490b589f3c1f33fea.png[/img]

You can also use a Kirisaur as a pack animal, instead of riding it. It can then carry up to 20 items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/162ecb9131e0109edc3c4cfc3c5548564e1c749c.png[/img]

Feed your Kirisaur spikefruits to keep it happy (and alive!). It will follow the person who fed it last, but only until it grows hungry again.
If you put blinders on a Kirisaur, it will believe that it is night and fall asleep. Once asleep it won't move around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4fbfb613450712a10f725caf30fa79610c41dbd0.png[/img]

You can also get Tomahawk Steaks from dead Kirisaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0a8d94ac5602f7c1aad55b104470cfc7fa951c7e.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Mechanism:[/b][/h2]
Running will consume more stamina when you carry heavy items, and less when you do not (both compared to previous release). Use backpacks, sleds and carts to make the stamina use less.
Walking is still not costing any stamina, even if you carry heavy items.


[h2][b]Other Updates [/b][/h2]

Kirisaur Mask

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4755cbf3d083fd233bb55241bd4fbffc642fd8e9.png[/img]

New container: Bucket

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f0222af3a6f5aafb32ff516b0a484e6d2b422e5a.png[/img]

Evo Oil: can be used to revitalize Kirisaur egg. Also now evo oil is required for Spiked Milk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0114a2e646878ca1f8fb1dda8bf7ae56470173b8.png[/img]

You can now grow moringa trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/c684ecdb3b3e2e55300927a1843a69da67149e96.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h2]
removed/improved some jumping of characters and/or animals that could happen occasionally.

notes.title: Tech Tree and Spirit Poles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/43ffa1428ad4c73e2cd94816a1dc8d2003470a01.png[/img]

[h2][b]Missions[/b][/h2]

Missions are no longer mandatory. They give rewards that accelerate your tech research, but you don't have to complete missions to advance

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/12047dd933e9c416c31b11090d97081f6cdd479b.png[/img]

Some missions have a timer on them now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/bd1573175c527c8cb3f6ae9c7ee21db612d692e3.png[/img]

[h2][b]Stage changes[/b][/h2]

There are now 3 stone age stages instead of 6, 2 bronze instead of 4, 2 iron instead of 4

[h2][b]New Tech Tree System[/b][/h2]

You show/hide the new tech tree by pressing this button:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/265ddc6805f4563b2b381a5cd05ef00b5388d7b5.png[/img]

Now each stage has its own tech tree, which must be completed in order to get to the next stage. Every tech discovery unlocks new craftable objects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/de23790956c88fe32a43b967bd358ef7e507a3a2.png[/img]

Researching tech is done by earning 3 types of points: Survival, Prosperity, Culture. These are earned by using your skills and by completing missions. You can see in the ICB what type of points are given for each object you can craft. Tribes on Hard and Master difficulties will earn points faster than tribes on Normal difficulty mode. when you fail with a skill, you still gain research points.

[b]3 types of mission points:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/2b7b759ccae46c93511470a273285e2fc81a38b9.png[/img]
-Survival points are earned through Gathering, Firestarting, Hunting, Butchering
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/7e0ab3accf9872754ba2d86422e379ab4909fd2c.png[/img]
-Prosperity points come from Toolmaking, Bronze Working, Blacksmithing, Farming, Mining, Forestry, Husbandry 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/35a7a24117907b6430bc5e3084296262b84d657f.png[/img]
-Culture is earned by Building, Cooking, Pottery, Sewing, Weaving, Woodworking



Note that when growing food, the digging and planting work is Farming, but picking the grown fruit (etc) is Gathering, so there will be both prosperity and survival points gained.


Every player can choose which technology to research next, by just clicking on it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/82b29a684543ba5ca401122590074ce9b9a1897b.png[/img]

You can see what everyone is working on here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0eb60d55ed21e8acd7a9b72fe8a89660691be396.png[/img]

If a player earns points of a category that is not needed for the research the player is currently focusing on, then the unused points will be kept here.  Any player can use these points for other discoveries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/13c3adf7cdf51d3d35ee9a3a57297b4aa1fcc2ec.png[/img]

When a tribe has completed Iron Age 2, it will now enter a Bonus Age. If you complete Bonus Age, Stage 1, there will be a Stage 2, and so on.

Missions will appear during the Bonus Age as well, so there will always be ways to earn extra points if you like. It also shows in the tribe selection gui.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/2fc2d80f45ea8f2335a7162bcc71d8ccaa28749d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/c5247e519a4d3feaf9182dfac4e53b7e04e5857f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Animal Mask and Spirit Poles[/b][/h2]

You can create these mask and use them to decorate spirit poles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/7d3c167e6975851d103f2c4d688a81f664df4ef2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/6be209b1b14207254ff05c56acaf7d93f61f5364.png[/img]

[h2][b]Tree Growing[/b][/h2]

You can grow full quiver trees in this update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/723fbbd7721a4fcf85b01935535728247f07fe56.png[/img]

[h2][b]New missions[/b][/h2]

There are more than 100 new missions added in this update.If you want more paralell missions, make sure to have some Elders in your tribe (age 50+), since this will add to the max number of active missions.

Remember that you need to eat different foods to increase your lifespan beyond 50 years.

[h2][b]Fewer Predators In Early Stages [/b][/h2]

Howlers and death-claws will not appear in stone age 1&2, but will appear when those have been completed.


[h2][b]Other Improvements [/b][/h2]

-Natural anvils can be made by cutting down the rock now (you can choose either making an anvil or getting the loose rocks for ores). Before you had to looks for the specific rock which turns to be an anvil but now it became easier to find a natural anvil.

-Vertical and horizontal walls, doors, etc... are now counted together, so you can mix building vertical and horizontal versions when fulfilling mission goals.

-Made cut trees heal over time

-Made it possible to get tanning bark from the tanning tree, even if there's a cut in tree.

-Changed the cooldown time to regain stamina.

 -Increased the effect of stamina power-ups

notes.title: Chinese New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f8903bf1e0eae6f0f24f3efcbc1fa6d20276c0a8.png[/img]

[h2][b]God of Wealth[/b][/h2]

The God of Wealth is like the Santa of Chinese New Years, he brings good wealth to all who welcome him. And now he will visit players to bring wealth to all tribes.

The God of Wealth will only visit your tribe in Stone Age 6 or later, And once he visits it will take 60 minutes before he will be ready to come visit again. 

When it's time for him to visit, a tribe member must use burning bamboo crackers to guide him to the tribe. If no one does this he will think no one lives here and leave. When a bamboo is burning he will appear close to a cairn on the map, looking for players. 

When you offer him a dumpling, he will bless you with a gift. He will bless each player with one gift per visit only. He will leave after five minutes or once all players have received their gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/fb9ef456e2d012968b63ec2f38a58576a0624d4b.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dumplings[/b][/h2]

Dumplings are a new food that can be made starting from Stone Age 6, and there is a special one that can be made in Bronze Age 4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/40a21cca7695ee3696afb95aaab1fdc7c6033825.png[/img]

[h2][b]Fire crackers[/b][/h2]

Legend says it can ward off bad spirits, but it can also guide the way for the God of Wealth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0150a6b493750ed437ce97bc3805d23e34246ca1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Sparklers[/b][/h2]

A fun and beautiful firecracker to play with at events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/67a0fccfa5a54158848087989906c35b399d15c1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Spring Couplets[/b][/h2]

A set of spring couplets that has writings about family harmony, and one for good fortune. You can use these to decorate your door and walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/140fdbd1961f7158311c3c4e0a9a19752df5d3f9.png[/img]

[h2][b]Chinese Knot[/b][/h2]

A decoration you can Receive from The God of Wealth, you can hang it on the wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/11db7f92aaf4d7b209f8c3a01f1d64099bafa8e5.png[/img]

[h2][b]Red Envelopes[/b][/h2]


One of the gifts from the God of Wealth is a red envelope, it contains 10 spirit fragments. The player that opens the envelop gets the 10 spirit fragments.

But don't just throw away the empty envelope, because you can also use it to gift 10 spirit fragments to each other. Each envelope can be reused 10 times before it disappears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/746a54f634dbe5c50b9d644f2ee3297dce840bb3.png[/img]

[h2][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2]

-It is possible to use a soup plate instead of leaf bowl for recipes that require a leaf bowl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/95a21cc02c7e17a9898cb5505f5831cf8d71c29d.png[/img]

-You can now move a baited fish trap to other locations.



[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

-Fixed the error that when you hold a one handed item and pick up four planks they end up held by one hand.

-Fixed the bug that you can create walls and tent holes on the same tile that already has a wall object.

-Fixed the bug where stones vanish when you disassemble a furnace/ oven structure while holding stones in hand.

-Fixed bug that when you hold two logs and pick up another two logs one log will vanish.

-Fixed bug where certain items could get stuck on sleds and become impossible to remove.

-Remove bugged sleds from the map

-Fixed the bug that when removing a wearable item (such as clothes) from an invisible wall results in the item being invisible.

notes.title: We Shall Be Bound by Oath
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/9c2b75ec337c998eaf7c5f29a432987af457a445.png[/img]

[h2][b]Oathbound[/b][/h2]

If two non-related adults stand close to each other while putting on matching oath arm rings, they will become bonded for life. The bond gives both players increased survival chances. If you try to wear an arm ring without taking the oath with someone, the ring will not stay on. The two rings also have to be a matching pair, or the oath will not happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/a81a1213d9ed7cf629f231e7bd4b03bb1519efb9.png[/img]

[h2][b]Family relations[/b][/h2]

You can now see how players are related to you, by right clicking on them. Babies can have both a mother and a father now, so not all mothers have to be single ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/e8b0158deb72a7ab428a387fca1ff856bd0b3148.png[/img]

[h2][b]Construction[/b][/h2]

You now have the option to install horizontal wood floors, which offers increased diversity for your flooring selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/8acdfa726be2933875c15308e14acc884e6684c1.png[/img]

You can build these tents inside desert areas. Not only are they nice looking, like other buildings they can also protect you from predators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/df921b0981d240a7dbd10041ea912d87287c435e.png[/img]

[h2][b]Cabinet[/b][/h2]

Introducing a new furniture piece equipped with a door, offering a convenient solution to help maintain a tidy workspace by concealing your belongings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/75a3508c35d83aef43e00929c9d5a9a1e9b56f03.png[/img]

[h2][b]Foraging[/b][/h2]

There are newly available food sources in the forest for harvesting, including four types of Fungi and a new kind of berry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/84cae544ee6b997c9e3647ff7d442b4aeda50283.png[/img]

You can also make mushroom stew with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/708d1d8ae45751304214a504515ebfa507eda400.png[/img]



[h2][b]Fishing update[/b][/h2]

You may utilize a slice of bread as bait, ensuring a consistently successful catch with this trap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/b8a8e0592c60827d0eb4b7e25ee140312b3f8658.png[/img]

Additionally, it is rather peculiar to observe the presence of vibrant, unfamiliar fish in the lakes. One plausible conjecture is that these fish have undergone a mutation of some sort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/fc36e8073c47c1924ad6bcf872d2bf2823f9c102.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Cookware[/b][/h2]

You can now make a cauldron and a griddle for cooking. They enhance heat efficiency, allowing for faster cooking and longer-lasting fires. Additionally, the fire's duration can be further prolonged by introducing larger firewood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/71db457413d8115a20abdcacf2176bdece877b4e.png[/img]

[h2][b]Santa Claus is Coming to Town[/b][/h2]

Santa will appear when your tribe starts a new stage (starting at stone age 4), and stay for 10 minutes. If you feed him a cooked hopper, he will give you something in return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/9c6e0e6702040f89c217d153b02271af5e9064e4.png[/img]

notes.title: The Autumn Forest
notes.content:
[h2][b]Autumn Forest[/b][/h2]

There is a newly discovered island adjacent to our main one, allowing easy access by wading. This island features a blend of the recently introduced forest biome and rocky biome enriched with iron ore deposits, although it will have limited food sources and no additional fauna. The island's bountiful resources will greatly support our iron age progression. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/9f95ebc3aa97f43fe09f47d55be89eb5b85e6649.png[/img]

[h2][b]Shelving[/b][/h2]

Open shelving adds both storage and display options to your space, giving your home a nice touch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/af4aad584414bebf40fb8514ab95d21317eb4453.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bamboo flooring[/b][/h2]
 
You can now create bamboo flooring, it can be placed on the ground or used for bridges.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/75ca989309c2b98a4c06dc5f7d64f2eb2a738cb5.png[/img]

[h2][b]Visual changes[/b][/h2]


Interestingly, there has been an enhancement in the lushness of the grass, rendering it visually appealing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/a5f44fc3e5e9810ea913b79705685d87901c3cc3.png[/img]

The appearance of the clay spots has undergone a transformation to resemble less like mud spots.(You can see the old look vs new look in the screenshot bellow)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/47f1c285e0dd04842c62c6086eed84152e31a943.png[/img]

[h2][b]Removing Natural Objects [/b][/h2] 

We have implemented methods to clear out the bushes and hopper holes enabling individuals to construct structures according to their preferences. Berry bushes still cannot be removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/fe1307d6adbdfae6ea713b931a21b1a0c50d25d8.png[/img]

[h2][b]Tribe Owner Powers[/b][/h2]

We implemented a feature that allows tribe owners to remove or exclude players from their tribes, as per their preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0ab08983d076ba8828293e3e022059a665155d09.png[/img]

[h2][b]More ferns for bowls[/b][/h2]
You can now harvest leaves from this fern to create leaf bowls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/fa6d124eacdc0e60e84e2598fdf59b7a0c9279b6.png[/img]

[h2][b]Longer life for Domestic Animals[/b][/h2]
The life period for domestic animals has been increased from 24 hours to 72 hours. Players can forgo attending to their needs for a day or two without resulting in their demise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/84b496f20d8a9a497186a78018423d199185121c.png[/img]

[h2][b]Desert Fang Nerf[/b][/h2]

The sand worm (also known as desert fang) will undergo a slight adjustment: its damage delivery will be more gradual, resembling that of a venom. This modification will allow sufficient time to apply a bandage and successfully survive a bite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/ca4ffe1a2bf7525485c5c8c0812e59d61c474238.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pottery Wheel Improvements[/b][/h2]

Previously, we could disassemble the pottery wheel by hand, and change the size of the clay clumps on the pottery wheel, resulting in the action icons becoming very messy. To improve it we have resorted to using a knife to disassemble the pottery wheel, and cutting the clay clumps in different sizes on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0a798ddb9d36c96bea6522ebd9db3faa9693fb57.png[/img]

We have included the size numbers on the clay clump icons for improved recognition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/458955147b6390830dbb39f0adcaed5f56a626ce.png[/img]

The clay clumps can also be utilized for filling the wooden casts.

[h2][b]Emptying containers[/b][/h2]

You are able to pour out water from a container, into a lake, river, or the sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/45967504965fb115f5bdfd6f113d551f59a3e205.png[/img]

notes.title: Taste of the Sea
notes.content:
[h2][b]Ocean Life[/b][/h2]

Life is thriving in the shallow waters at present, potentially making them a viable food source.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/b85d31550c70001dfb4541fad198f880c060ab68.png[/img]

One can gather a wide array of resources in the shallows of the ocean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/e51b6c3fad91133298c3333256ba91820852febd.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bridges[/b][/h2]

After recognizing the challenges of crossing the river, humans devised a solution to facilitate transportation by constructing bridges.

Also for some inexplicable reason, there appears to be a noticeable alteration in the appearance of the lakes, potentially attributable to the phenomenon of climate change?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/91687b8f3a4abcd996f5b5df41d3ddfd5061d5a4.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pottery Wheel[/b][/h2]

The crafting steps for pottery have been changed and a pottery wheel is now required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/23c3b2dc96988578f0b0e307441df87afabc4af4.png[/img]


You have the ability to create a versatile Fruit Bowl that can accommodate a variety of items, including meat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/7cc0df77632f57d7fe493a29944fb78256edc10a.png[/img]

[h2][b]Shoes[/b][/h2]

After recognizing the need for foot protection, humans have honed their skills in crafting shoes, resulting in not only functional footwear but also enhancing the overall aesthetics of outfits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/6c2ea85949dd5b1b0deda57fcf98a7059003c437.png[/img]

[h2][b]Anvil[/b][/h2]

Some humans have grown weary of the arduous task of searching for stones to shape into anvils, therefore they have acquired the knowledge to manufacture them through casting processes. This particular technique is exclusively acquired during the era of Iron Age 4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/3b6b6fea92f954047cdcf5d673ff6f200bf94cb6.png[/img]

notes.title: Spirit Fragments and more!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Tribe Ownership and Invitations[/b][/h2]
1. We removed the system with resurrection points on tribes. There will no longer be a point where the tribe "dies". It can be resurrected as many times as you like, using personal points that you earn by playing on other tribes. More about this a little further down.
2. The founder of a tribe will now be considered the leader/owner of that tribe. The owner gets to invite other players either as members of the tribe, or as temporary guests. Only owners and members will have the power to resurrect a tribe.
We don't want an unlimited number of tribes, so there will be a cost of personal points to create a new tribe too.
3. When the change is rolled out we will look at the three adopted tribe slots you have. Those that are tribes you founded, you will be made the leader/owner of, and the others you will be made a tribe member of. Tribes that are not saved by anyone will disappear.
4. The owner can decide that the tribe should be publicly shown, which means that it is shown in the list of public tribes and anyone can join as a temporary guest. Conversely, the tribe can be hidden, so only players will an invitation code can join them. 
Member invitations will be time-limited and have one single use. These are suitable for giving to friends in personal messages.
Guest invitations are multiple use and not time-limited. You can terminate them when you want though. These are suitable for posting in groups, on streams, etc...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/2aa78227798e0c23acb65b21856deb13a4479b9b.png[/img]

This means that you can also have "private" tribes either for solo play or to play on only with some selected friends. However, it will not be free to play on these. It will cost points to resurrect an offline tribe, and also to keep a tribe online. The fewer you are, the more each player has to contribute. This is done so that we can accommodate the request for private tribes without ruining ourselves paying rent for unlimited numbers of servers.
More on how these points will be earned in the next part. 

[h2][b]Spirit Fragments[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/3d7c6621ac45b7010503de1d13bfc5a30421da4e.png[/img]
5. When contributing to another player's tribe, you will earn spirit fragments. These will be issued when you die and depend on how much experience you achieved in the different skills. Why experience? Because it's a measurement of how much you have achieved for the tribe. It's not a linear relationship though. The more experience in the same skill, the harder it will be to gain more points with that skill. This is reset per calendar day though, so it's fine to concentrate on a smaller number of skills in each life, but if you just do the same actions over and over during several lives, you will earn fewer and fewer points that day.
6. A tribe needs "energy" to stay alive and to be resurrected. Your spirit fragments provide this energy. The player who resurrects the tribe has to pay enough points for the tribe to stay online for a full lifespan. When a player joins a live tribe, that player has to contribute enough for the tribe to stay alive until they die of old age. This can be more or less, depending on how much energy the tribe already has when this player joins. There is also a minimum amount that each player has to pay, even if the tribe has enough energy, because this makes it more fair between players over time.

This means that if you wish to play alone in one of your tribes, you always have to earn enough spirit fragments to resurrect that tribe yourself, since no-one else is sharing the cost with you. These fragments are earned by helping others. 

[h2][b]Potted Plants[/b][/h2]
You can now have potted plants to decorate your house!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/479fefd02ff7670acfb6544896aae8943853d60a.png[/img]

It's still challenging, but not impossible any more 🙂

notes.title: Tribe System Update
notes.content:
In this update we made some big game changing changes. Instead of the play being island based it is now tribe based. You start a new tribe and try to not die out while reaching the technology goals together. If your tribe dies out you can still resurrect it as long as there are any resurrection points left.

[b]Beginner tribes[/b] work similarly like islands did before: they are not connected to any individual players and once one is started it stays online until it has been finished (meaning end of stone age in this case), no matter how long it takes. New beginner tribes will start automatically, so there will always be one to play on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/e5a65af9ae702c12202e6d7d3f8393e969a406c8.png[/img]

[b]Standard tribes[/b] will be started and named by you players. They will go online when players are active on them, and will go offline when no-one is playing on them. When a player activates a tribe it will become visible for other players to join also. The tribes can be resurrected from offline (dead) status several times, but not infinitely. Each player can only resurrect a limited number of tribes.

You will have three slots for your favorite tribes. It can be both tribes you have started yourself and tribes that you have joined after someone else started them. Creating or adopting a tribe as yours, grants you the power to resurrect it from offline (dead) state.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/81c7750d64326386b4f64160dbe6ea6609bbabff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0ae89c02d361ed5eeac0d3ada9a7cd3815733b7c.png[/img]


Skills will be mapped differently on different difficulty levels, and experience gain will be slower on lower difficulty and faster on higher difficulty.

Hunger rate, animal behaviors, and wound seriousness will also change with the difficulty levels. On higher difficulty you won't be able to stand around inactively for as long before you start starving, animals get stronger and less afraid of fire, etc...

In this update we also added wooden chests and tables :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f379167cb4db8d98d12d159261142a52c2d26fda.png[/img]

And you can mine copper and tin lodes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f10a592805dcba1db2f9808edfa6c4dd26987b44.png[/img]

notes.title: Price increase on July 1st!
notes.content:
The target price for In Next Life on PC/Mac is $20 for the official release version. During the Early Access period, we have three price steps:
1. $11 for the really early adopters
2. $15 for the mid-early adopters
3. $20 for those who join shortly before the official release

The change from $11 to $15 will happen on July 1st, so in three days from now. If you have considered to buy the game, but haven't gotten around to it yet, then you may want to consider doing it now.


Some info on what's up next, in the early July update:

The current gameplay will change and there will be two game modes, "Beginner" and "Normal". 
Beginner will be fairly similar to today's gameplay, but there will be some modifications.
Normal will add some mechanics that make it quite different. A tribe will no longer have unlimited lives to reach the end of the development stages. If you make too many mistakes or die too easily, your tribe will fail. The survival and challenge aspects of the game will play a larger part in the gameplay. It's gonna be a lot of fun, we hope!

Cheers,

// The INL Team

Hi players,

Time for a content and ease-of-use update!


[b]Farming[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/25afbfe631c2bf59fbd1904a7bebcda88d4b6aa8.gif[/img]
Take survival to the next level by starting to grow your own foods and materials.
Stone age level farming means digging a hole, inserting seeds or pieces of tubers, cover with soil and adding water. Then you wait...


[b]Pottery[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/3be01656fdde65551f506520a860597cafb1c650.png[/img]
You can now find clay in the jungle. Use it to shape pottery, which you fire in the new fire pit to make it solid.

We added a new recipe for soup: gather all ingredients on a work mat, grab a knife and water and mix it all together in the new clay bowl. Then heat it by the fire and share it with your tribe.


[b]Improved Crafting Info[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4b0960de518a1fcafedb5d6cf3e9e49167273081.png[/img]
The ICB (Item and Crafting Browser) has been overhauled to present the crafting steps in a clearer way, with the most important details showing first.

The steps are inverted, so you always see the final steps without scrolling, and steps for making some of the sub-ingredients have been hidden, to improve quick understanding (just click on any item to see the steps for creating it though).


[b]Improved Item Selection[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/3fafa8181014c8c83ce8acd6cfc01f9ba1e4562c.png[/img]
You can now choose exactly which item you want to pick out from a container.

- Nerfed deadly animals, so they are easier to escape from
- Dead Howlers and Death-Claws now disappear after 1h
- You can now remove wall frames
- Nerfed banana trees (now 15 minutes to respawn)
- Cutting a fern into leaves is now a harvest action

notes.title: Game Update: Animal Attacks!
notes.content:
Hi players!

If you have read through the information under "Early Access" you know that the development is currently focusing on bringing more challenges to the game play. The first instalment is this update with wild animals that can chase you, harm you, and potentially kill you.
Bandages for your wounds will follow in a later update, so survival will get tricky in our world for a while. Don't worry though - as long as your tribe builds enough Cairns to show the way, you can always respawn and find your way back to what you were doing before those pesky animals killed you ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/feba6531351bcf6f9896470f64ccafed433ad6bc.gif[/img]
The Howlers are hunting in packs of 3-4 animals. They chase both Hoppers, Zezelles, and humans. They will prefer slower individuals, like children or elderly players, so the tribe must try and keep these vulnerable people safe!
Killing one of the pack will make the others abandon the fight. If you don't have a spear, then RUN! If you run far enough, they will lose interest. Running though jungle is also a good way to confuse them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/fc98273b00dca606a33a0f049c75d597c9daa39c.gif[/img]
The Death-Claw is usually alone. If you go too close to it, it will start stalking you and will eventually charge. The best you can do when it charges is to run. It will chase you for a while, but will eventually get exhausted. At that point you can escape, but if your goal is to kill the Death-Claw, then your only chance is to succeed with a spear thrust while it is exhausted. If you fail, it will immediately attack you again.
We do not recommend anyone taking on a Death-Claw on their own. If you collaborate, then one player can act as a lure, while the other player conserves their stamina and then attack when the Death-Claw is exhausted. Death-Claws will hunt and eat Zezelles, so they can be used to distract it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/390045e226282a010fd965f1479ae7dba8d2cfec.gif[/img]
The Chickarex is [i]not[/i] your pet! If you go too close to its nest while it is close, it will attack.
On the other hand, chickarexes will also attack Howlers and Death-Claws, and can be used to distract them.

You can get wounded multiple times. Each wound will deal some direct damage and some damage over time. A light wound shows as scratches on your arm, while a medium one shows as claw marks on your thigh. If you get a large wound on your chest and abdomen, then it will be a mortal one. Use the time you have left to say farewell to your fellow tribe members ːsteamsadː
You can't generate health while you are still wounded, but as soon as the wounds are healed, you will begin to generate health again (as long as you have eaten enough food)

Finally, fire is a good way to keep dangerous animals away. Consider having several fires going at your camp at all times.
